tool.name: DescribeFeatureServices

param.name: folder
param.dialogReference: The folder of your content to search. The list is filled from your account when the dialog opens: (all my folders), (root folder) and each of your folders. The default is (all my folders).

param.name: tag
param.dialogReference: Only items that carry this tag (not case sensitive), for example a tag you give your test items. Leave it empty for every hosted feature layer in the folder.

param.name: out_csv
param.dialogReference: The CSV file to write: one row per layer or table with item_title, item_id, sharing, layer, geometry, features, fields, editable, modified, size_kb and thumbnail.

param.name: service_count
param.dialogReference: The number of feature service items described.

tool.summary: Writes a CSV report of the hosted feature layers you own in the portal ArcGIS Pro is signed in to: one row per layer with its geometry type, number of features, number of fields, sharing level and last change.
tool.usage:
• Sign in to ArcGIS Online (or your ArcGIS Enterprise portal) in ArcGIS Pro first. The tool connects with the ArcGIS API for Python, GIS("pro"): no user name, password or token is stored in the tool.

  • Only items you own are read. The tool changes nothing in the portal.

  • Feature counts come from a count query on each layer; a layer with many features still answers quickly.

dataIdInfo.idPurp: Inventory the hosted feature layers you own to a CSV report.
